resources.string: Watch a short video to unlock this reward and continue.
Add, import or edit individual FastFlags
Applies your selected optimizations whenever you save and launch. Turn this off to start Roblox with its normal configuration.
Overrides Roblox MSAA with an Android-compatible FastFlag.
Selects a fixed Roblox render-quality level from 1 to 21.
Choose graphics for your next launch. Vulkan and OpenGL preferences cannot be on together. Unsupported drivers may fall back safely.
Caps the internal 16:9 render pixel budget while keeping the Android UI at native size.
Bypasses the default 240 FPS limit for maximum framerate.
Enter the FPS target Masterstrap should request on the next launch (30–9999). Actual FPS still depends on the game, GPU and display driver.
Hide default names above characters on the next Roblox launch. Does not hide chat, the player list or custom name tags made by a game.
Forces graphics to level 1 when you launch patched Roblox through Masterstrap. Turn off to choose the quality in Roblox; low quality may reduce shader effects. No root needed.
Uses Roblox\'s native ReducedMotion setting to stop or reduce supported motion effects. Requires root.
Controls Roblox\'s native HapticStrength setting. Disable it to remove supported vibration feedback. Requires root.
Reduces anti-aliasing, visual effects and grass while optimizing 3D model memory to prioritize FPS.
Uses simpler versions of distant 3D models to reduce graphics and memory load.
Skips very high-resolution texture levels to reduce RAM and graphics-memory use.
Automatically balances memory used for 3D models on Android devices.
Loads 3D models earlier to reduce objects appearing late during gameplay.
Uses Roblox’s optimized handling path for games containing many objects.
Turns off most in-game shadows to reduce GPU load and improve performance, especially on lower-end devices.
Removes bloom, blur, depth-of-field and similar effects to reduce GPU load.
Sets grass rendering distances to zero to reduce graphics work in outdoor scenes.
Replaces the normal sky with a simple gray background for a cleaner, lighter scene.
Removes the blurred background behind Roblox menus for a clearer and slightly lighter interface.
Automatically reduces render resolution when the GPU is overloaded to help gameplay stay smooth.
Simplifies character animations at a distance to reduce CPU load in crowded games.
Synchronizes rendered frames with the display to reduce screen tearing and uneven motion.
Allows Roblox to adjust render resolution according to the device’s available graphics performance.
Uses actual GPU frame timing to adjust graphics more accurately when performance changes.
Groups game asset requests to reduce repeated network work while joining and loading a game.
Applies an experimental high-rate movement and physics network profile. Results depend on the game and connection.
%1$s preset applied (%2$d flags). Tap Start to launch Roblox.
Lets Roblox cooperate with Android power management when the game is running in the background.
Helps Roblox restore its session correctly after returning from recent apps or the background.
Balances memory reserved for 3D models to reduce excessive RAM use on Android devices.
Removes terrain material textures for a simpler look and may reduce graphics load. Some games may look flat or unusual.
Keeps animation data ready in memory to avoid decoding the same animation repeatedly.
Activates a one-shot native performance profile only when Roblox is launched from Masterstrap.
Lets Roblox report loading, gameplay and measured CPU work to Android so the scheduler can allocate performance without root.
Prefers the fastest available CPU cluster for critical Roblox threads when supported.
Performs one measured native-heap trim after startup; never runs a periodic cleaner.
Keeps Wi-Fi in high-performance mode during gameplay to reduce radio wake-up delays.
Keeps the Roblox CPU awake during the session; Android thermal limits still apply.
Removes the launch animation and warms mapped Roblox code pages once at startup.
Requests a session-scoped screen wake lock from inside Roblox.
Requests Android low-latency Wi-Fi from the foreground Roblox process and automatically becomes inactive when Roblox leaves the foreground.
Monitors Android thermal status during startup and reduces performance hints before heat causes severe throttling.
Requests the closest seamless display refresh rate directly from the active Roblox surface. This complements the Roblox FPS target without forcing an unsupported Hz mode.
Uses Android Sustained Performance Mode on supported devices to trade a small amount of peak speed for steadier performance during long sessions.
Select which Roblox app to use and launch
Configure launch-only display behavior for Roblox patched
Choose a lighting and color style for the next Masterstrap launch
Add glossy, reflective surfaces to your selected Shader Package. Applies once to compatible surfaces near you.
Below 100% widens the picture. Above 100% makes the picture narrower. 100% keeps the original shape.
Applied once in landscape only when Roblox patched is launched from Masterstrap. The 101–200% range uses a wider render buffer and can increase GPU memory use.
Enter your license key to unlock full features & bypass ads.
Asks Android to reclaim unused memory from Masterstrap before Roblox opens. It affects only Masterstrap and never closes another app.
Temporarily asks Android for low-latency Wi-Fi while Roblox opens. It works only when the device is connected through Wi-Fi.
Keep the CPU awake while Roblox starts
Prevents the processor from sleeping for up to 60 seconds while Roblox starts. It does not overclock or change the CPU speed.
Pause launch boosts when the device is too hot
Checks Android’s temperature status before launch. If severe heat is detected, Wi-Fi and CPU launch boosts are skipped until the device cools down.
Faster touch screen response for instant character control without input lag.
Balances frame delivery for silky-smooth motion without micro-stutters.
Please enable Game Mode Turbo first!
Choose one optimized game preset. Its flags are merged with your controls when you save and launch.
